faq.question: Do I need to book an appointment in advance?
faq.answer: Walk-ins are welcome during opening hours (Mon–Sat 8AM–6PM, Sunday 12PM–6PM). For a guaranteed slot, especially for longer packages, book online or ask staff to reserve a future time.

faq.question: What should I wear to my shoot?
faq.answer: Wear something you feel confident and comfortable in. Solid colours tend to photograph beautifully, but we encourage you to express your personal style. For corporate shoots, smart/professional attire works best. For birthday and personal shoots, feel free to wear outfits that reflect your personality — you can even bring a change of clothing!

faq.question: How long does a typical shoot take?
faq.answer: The session occupies the full booked package duration. Individual sessions often run 30–60 minutes. Family, kids, and pre-wedding sessions may be longer depending on the package.

faq.question: When will I receive my photos?
faq.answer: Passport and visa photos are typically printed the same day. For other sessions, standard delivery is 3–4 working days. Express delivery (within 24 hours, max 8 photos) is available for +30%. Confirm current turnaround with the team when you arrive.

faq.question: Can I use my own phone to take photos in the studio?
faq.answer: Yes. There is a dedicated Personal Arena space for mobile shoots. Lighting and backdrops are prepared; you create the frames. This is included in personal shoot packages — mention it when you arrive.

faq.question: Do you offer studio rental for photographers?
faq.answer: Yes. Studio hire starts from ₦40,000 per hour on the current provisional list and includes access to backdrops, props, and lighting. Call 09059813823 to check availability. Individual booths and backdrops can also be hired separately.

faq.question: How do I pay for my session?
faq.answer: Online bookings are paid in full through Bachs and receive a 5% discount. Walk-in and staff-created reservations can be paid at the studio (cash or bank transfer). Bookings are non-refundable. Rescheduling attracts a 15% charge. 7.5% VAT is applied to client bills.
